# This is Suricata version 8.0.8 RELEASE, run by make-stream-verdicts.py; do not edit by hand.
# 'rule SID RULE', or 'refused SID RULE' when Suricata does not load it,
# then 'packet NS HEX SIDS': the packet's time in nanoseconds, its IP
# bytes and the sids that alerted on it, a sid once per alert, '-' for none,
# then 'end N SIDS': what alerted when connection N was flushed at the
# end of the capture, its last address byte being N.
rule 6000 alert tcp any any -> any any (msg:"stream 6000"; content:"ABCDEF"; flow:established,to_server;)
rule 6001 alert tcp any any -> any any (msg:"stream 6001"; content:"ABCDEF"; flow:established,to_server,only_stream;)
rule 6002 alert tcp any any -> any any (msg:"stream 6002"; content:"ABCDEF"; flow:established,to_server,no_stream;)
